predicate contains_vertex(v: option[int], verts: list[option[int]]) {
    (is_none(v) ∨
        (∃(i: int) ::
            ((((0 <= i < len(verts)) ∧
                is_some(v)) ∧
                is_some(verts[i])) ∧
                (unwrap(v) == unwrap(verts[i])))))
}
